data.readme:
1. 新增支持 Switch 2 主机。
2. 修复连接 Classic 手柄时摇杆异常的问题。
data.readme_en:
1. Added support for Switch 2.
2. Fixed abnormal joystick behavior when connecting the Classic controller.

data.readme:
1. 修复打开升级助手时 NGC 手柄异常振动的问题。
2. 修复 Switch 模式游玩 N64 Online 游戏异常振动的问题。
3. 修复 NGC 手柄摇杆异常的问题。
data.readme_en:
1. Fixed the abnormal rumble issue of the NGC controller when run the 8BitDo Upgrade Tool.
2. Fixed the abnormal rumble issue in Switch mode when playing with N64 Online games.
3. Fixed the abnormal joysticks issue of the NGC controller.

data.readme: 1. 修复 GameCube 手柄连接不稳定的问题。
data.readme_en: 1. Fixed the unstable connection issue when use the GameCube controller.

data.readme:
1. 修复 Switch 模式异常断连问题。
2. 优化电池电量检测的准确性。
data.readme_en:
1. Fixed abnormal disconnect issue on Switch mode.
2. Optimized the accuracy of battery level detection.

data.readme: 1. 增加 Switch 模式的插线配对。
data.readme_en: 1. Added bluetooth pairing function via USB cable on Switch mode.

data.readme:
1. 修复与 Joy-Con 同时使用出现的延迟。
2. 增加 SFC / NES Classic 手柄热键功能（按住组合键 5 秒进行切换，切换时红灯闪一下）：

SELECT+Dpad_Up: 十字键
SELECT+Dpad_Left: 左摇杆
SELECT+Dpad_Right: 右摇杆
data.readme_en:
1. Fixed the latency issue when using with Switch Joy-cons attached. 
2. Add the HOT KEY for SNES/NES Classic controller:

Press and hold HOT KEY for 5 seconds to map DPAD and other buttons, LED will blink once in red when successful: 
SELECT + UP: DPAD = DPAD
SELECT + LEFT: DPAD = LEFT JOYSTICK
SELECT + RIGHT: DPAD =  RIGHT JOYSTICK

data.readme:
1. 修复玩大乱斗的输入延迟问题。
2. 修复调用 amiibo 的错误弹窗问题。
data.readme_en:
1. Fixed input lag issue when playing SUPER SMASH BROS.
2. Fixed the pop-up window error when using amiibo.

data.readme:
1. 修复 GameCube 摇杆不识别问题。
2. 修复 Wii Classic/Pro 不识别问题。
3. 修复 Wii Classic/Pro 摇杆漂移问题。
4. 增加 GameCube 手柄在 Xinput 模式下，L2、R2的模拟量。
data.readme_en:
1. Fixed the issue of the GameCube joystick recognition issue.
2. Fixed the issue of Wii Classic/Pro recognition issue.
3. Fixed the issue of joystick drifting when using Wii Classic and Wii Classic pro. 
4. Add analog function to L2 and R2 on GameCube controller on Xinput mode.

data.readme:
1. 修复插拨 GameCube 手柄时摇杆会有几秒漂移的问题。
2. 增加 GameCube 手柄 L、R 键轻按效果。
3. 增加 Switch Pro 手柄布局与 GC 手柄布局切换功能（L+R+A+B+START)。

Note：按住热键（L+R+A+B+START）绿灯亮表示切换为 GC 布局，红灯亮表示切换为 Switch Pro 布局
data.readme_en:
1. Fixed it will be few seconds of drift when plug and unplug problem.
2. Added shoulder button function to L & R buttons when lightly pressed. 
3. Added button mapping funtion which can be swapped between Switch Pro and GameCube (L+R+A+B+START).

Note: Press and hold L+R+A+B+START to swap button mapping option between GameCube (Green LED indication) and Switch Pro (Red LED indication).
